description: Application-owned offline wrapper for one explicitly selected Utah Business List workbook and three operator-derived sheet exports.
redirect_policy: No HTTP requests, redirects, discovery, automated acquisition, purchase, or account creation are permitted.
retry: No automatic retry. Inspect the durable receipt and replace or correct the explicitly selected package.
checkpoint: One UUID operation owns its durable start record, temporary input snapshot, immutable local-review release, and terminal receipt.
idempotency: Five input SHA-256 values bind each operation. Re-running creates a distinct UUID operation and never changes a current pointer.
cancellation: Cancellation is cooperative. The operation records CANCELLED and removes only its unpublished snapshot and operation-owned release; selected package inputs are never modified.
retention_profile: Operator inputs remain under data/imports. Person-free normalized evidence and receipts remain local-review-only and admission-ineligible.
